text: {"lessons":["My account value rose overall despite several monthly declines, so I should judge progress over a longer horizon rather than react to short-term moves.","I added to Stock A and E after initially buying them; before adding again, I should check that any position remains appropriately sized and diversified.","A few trades and a strong recent run do not guarantee future returns; I should invest consistently, keep suitable cash reserves, and stay focused on my apartment goal."]}
